creator.title: Invite a member to compare your passports
creator.description: Choose the sections to compare. The other member will see the exact request before agreeing.
creator.error: The invitation could not be created. Check the public sections in your passport.

VisitedParks.title: Visited parks
VisitedParks.description: Compare the parks and countries included in your public selections.

PersonalRatings.title: Preferences
PersonalRatings.description: Compare only the personal ratings each member chose to publish.

YearlyActivity.title: Years and activity
YearlyActivity.description: Compare the pace of shared visits and rides by year.

MissedItems.title: Missed attractions
MissedItems.description: Find the public experiences that each of you missed.

accept.title: Review before comparing
accept.description: Nothing is compared until both of you approve the same sections.

accept.acceptedDescription: The comparison can now be prepared from the passport versions you approved.
accept.proof: Only the public sections above will be used. Private data and technical identifiers remain excluded.

status.Accepted: This invitation has already received both approvals.
status.OwnInvitation: You cannot accept your own invitation.

status.InviteePassportUnavailable: First make your passport public and allow comparisons.
